notes:
Background: HelioForge builds an outbound sales assistant that lives in reps' inbox and CRM. Current stack: internal microservice + third-party LLM provider (high cost, inconsistent streaming latency). Team wants low-latency streaming + tool calling for CRM/email/calendar actions.

POC ask: 2-week hosted POC to validate streaming-first-byte and tool-call roundtrips (CRM write, calendar create) under representative concurrency (30 concurrent sessions). If hosted meets SLOs, commercial discussion about Dedicated reserved capacity (predictable throughput) and contract.

Quotes from calls: 'We need sub-200ms first-byte for streaming UI to feel real to reps' — Head of Product. 'Tool calls must be idempotent and auditable, audit logs are mandatory' — Security.

Cost sensitivity: mid-level — will trade some latency for cost but pilot wants realistic cost model (token + infra) and quantization recommendations. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/caching.

Security: must support SSO/SAML, customer-managed KMS for dedicated, and EU data residency for some accounts (multiregional). Procurement wants SOC2/ISO references before signing.

Current status summary: Hosted API demo (streaming + tool calling) complete; POC under way. Engineering running latency tests against hosted endpoint (k6 scripts). SE notes some cold-start artifacts on bursty requests; asked for kernel/quantization guidance.

Sales/Commercial: requesting a committed pricing quote for Dedicated pilot (3x A100-equivalent, 6-month term) + overage rates. Finance to review TCO vs current vendor.
